events.label: Brazil G20 presidency climate governance push

slots.name: presidency date
slots.sentence: In 2024, Brazil’s Presidency of the G20 helped encourage structural changes in national economies and the international financial system to respond to climate-related ecological transformation, and pushed for strengthened climate governance, including through a possible new U.N. Climate Change Council to accelerate implementation of the Paris Agreement.
